sections.title: Identification and habitat
sections.text: Kew treats the catalogue name Neocallitropsis pancheri as a synonym of Callitris pancheri. This small evergreen conifer from New Caledonia is about 2–10 m tall and grows in open maquis on ultramafic soils.

sections.title: Foliage and cones
sections.text: The fibrous bark exfoliates. Adult foliage is scale-like. The woody female cones, about 10 × 8 mm, have eight scales in two whorls; male cones are about 8–10 × 6 mm.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: No food use is established. The currently accepted name and the catalogue's older name refer to the same taxon.
